content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OSH&FW Kalahandi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.kalahandi.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OSH&FW Kalahandi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator post is 29th September 2026. For Medical Officer AYUSH, candidates need to attend the walk-in-interview on 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the OSH&FW Kalahandi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the posts of Medical Officer AYUSH (Homeopathy)-Mobile Health Unit (MHU) and Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator (SSMTC)-NVBDCP.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Medical Officer post is a Bachelor degree in Homeopathic Medicine & Surgery (BHMS) from a recognized University, completion of Internship Training, and a valid registration from the Odisha State Council/Board of Homeopathic Medicine.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator post is between 21 to 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Offline. For Medical Officer AYUSH, it involves attending a walk-in-interview, while for Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator, applications are to be sent via Registered Post/Speed Post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer AYUSH post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Officer AYUSH post is Rs. 31,000 plus a KBK incentive of Rs. 4000 and a Performance Incentive (Max 25%), along with other applicable incentives.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator post includes a Written-cum-Computer test (MS Office) and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Odisha State Health & Family Welfare Kalahandi, which is www.kalahandi.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for both the Medical Officer and Sentinel Site Malaria Technician-cum-Coordinator posts is Contractual engagement.
